content.text: Default should be email. Check register in auth service.

content.thinking: Registration creates every user with the google provider, so email/password login rejects them, because UsersService.create falls back to google and the email path never passes a provider. I traced this by reading the code only, without running the app or tests.

candidates.explanation: The provider falls back to AuthProvidersEnum.google when createUserDto.provider is undefined. AuthService.register calls usersService.create without a provider, so every email-registered user is stored with provider 'google'. Login then sees user.provider !== 'email' and returns 422 'needLoginViaProvider:google'. The default should be AuthProvidersEnum.email.
The register call does not set provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email explicitly, so it relies on the wrong default in UsersService.create.

fix.description: Change the default provider in UsersService.create from AuthProvidersEnum.google to AuthProvidersEnum.email. Optionally also pass provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email explicitly in AuthService.register.
